title: M2 detection input accepted by M3 adapter v1
description: image_base64 is the existing encoder crop. Source RGB original image may instead be supplied as an in-process original_rgb argument. Source ROI PNG and ROI-coordinate binary mask PNG are recommended. This is a handoff contract, not an installed M2 HTTP schema.

mask_base64.description: Plain base64 PNG, single-channel, binary 0/1/255, same H/W and origin as the selected source ROI. Not a full-image mask.

bbox.description: [x1,y1,x2,y2] original-image coordinates, x2/y2 exclusive; required at runtime if original_rgb is provided and source_roi_base64 is absent.
